final_redemption_amount.check: No percentage is printed; principal amount payable at stated maturity is implied (prospectus supplement page 6), and the pricing supplement only says the notes may not be redeemed or repaid before the Maturity Date

record_date.value: February 24 and August 27 preceding the applicable Interest Payment Date

rounding_rule.check: Prospectus supplement page 13 rounds dollar amounts to the nearest cent, half cent up, but only for floating rate notes; nothing is stated for fixed rate notes

notes: The documents give only a CUSIP (69371RU79, pricing supplement page 1) and no ISIN, so isin is null. The pricing supplement is a two-page form for Medium-Term Notes, Series R - Fixed Rate; it states amount, dates, rate, record dates and currency but no day count, business day rule or USD denomination ('Minimum Denominations' applies only to non-U.S. dollar notes). Those come from the Series R prospectus supplement of November 7, 2024 inside paccar-s3asr-2024: denominations of USD 1,000 and integral multiples of USD 1,000 (page 7, S-4); 'Business Day' is a New York banking day (page 8, S-5); interest from and including the date of issue on a 360-day year of twelve 30-day months, and payment on a non-Business Day made on the next succeeding Business Day as if made on the due date, with no interest for the delay (page 10, S-7). The pricing supplement overrides the default record dates (March 1 or September 1 for fixed rate notes, page 10) with February 24 and August 27, and overrides the default March 15 / September 15 interest payment dates with March 10 / September 10. Original Issue Date is September 10, 2026 (T+5). The first coupon (2026-09-10 to 2027-03-10) is a regular full period; no coupon amounts are printed.
